tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Search OEM replacement parts and laptop models by free text (model name, part number, part type such as battery or screen). Returns part numbers with the official source URL for each fit. Each part includes buy_links (paid affiliate where-to-buy links: eBay and Amazon searches, plus Newegg/LPScreen

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List laptop and Chromebook models covered, optionally filtered by brand (e.g. Lenovo, Dell, HP) or category (chromebook, business-laptop).

tools.name: get_model_parts
tools.description: Get every documented OEM replacement part for one laptop model, with constraints and the official source URL for each fit. Accepts a model slug (from list_models) or model name. If the name is ambiguous (e.g. "T14") it returns status "ambiguous" with candidate models instead of guessing; ask the use

tools.name: get_part_fits
tools.description: Look up an OEM part number and list every laptop model it is documented to fit, with the official source URL for each fit. tools.name: find_repair_guides
tools.description: Find step-by-step replacement guides (battery, SSD, RAM, keyboard, fan, speakers, RTC battery, WLAN, etc.) paraphrased from official service manuals. Filter by model (slug or name; ambiguous names return candidates) and/or component. Also lists topics that are not yet covered (no steps published). G

tools.name: get_repair_guide
tools.description: Get one repair guide by slug (from find_repair_guides): full Markdown steps with page citations, the official manual URL, HP service classification and scope restrictions. Not bench-tested; follow the scope restrictions and the OEM manual.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
